# Job Application Tracker

> An open-source (Apache-2.0), self-hosted, local-first web app for tracking a job search,
> built for software engineers. It tracks applications, recruiters and agencies (one
> recruiter can have many roles), configurable interview stages with timestamped history,
> numbered interview rounds described in the user's own words ("Round 2 · System design
> test"), duplicate-submission warnings, Markdown notes, attachments and exported emails,
> CV and cover-letter versions, a "Next actions" page for stalled applications, and
> insights: a Sankey diagram of the funnel, conversion and time per stage, direct vs
> recruiter outcomes and a recruiter scorecard. It never scrapes job boards or contacts
> anyone, and all data stays in one local directory outside the code.

Status: early development (0.1.0); every planned feature is built but not yet tested in real
use (see CHANGELOG.md). Available now: a Next actions home page
(follow-ups due, applications gone quiet, interviews coming up, one-click follow-up, snooze
and Ghosted), applications list and Kanban board (move between any stages), application,
company, recruiter and agency pages, recruiter CRM, numbered interview rounds, duplicate
warnings, Markdown notes as real files, links, file attachments and `.eml` import onto the
timeline, versioned CVs and cover letters, an Insights page (Sankey diagram of stage flows
filtered by date and route; conversion and median time per stage; direct vs recruiter
outcomes; weekly activity; a recruiter and agency scorecard), offers compared side by side
(salary, bonus, equity, pension and holiday, or day rate, IR35 and length, with a
worth-a-year figure and reply deadlines in Next actions), git-backed snapshots, a one-click
zip backup of the whole data directory (`GET /api/v1/backup/archive` or `jat archive`),
restore (`jat restore`), and full-text search across everything, notes included
(`GET /api/v1/search?q=`, or press / in the app).

Stack: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic and SQLite (with a JSON Lines export
committed to the user's private data repo); React 19, TypeScript, Mantine, TanStack
Router/Query and d3-sankey. Run with `uv run jat --data-dir <dir> serve`
(http://127.0.0.1:8770); try demo data with `uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py /tmp/jat-demo`.
The JSON API is documented at http://127.0.0.1:8770/api/docs; insights live under
`/api/v1/insights/` (`flow`, `stats`, `activity`, `scorecard`).
